description: Drift widget loader on js.driftt.com/include/{cacheWindow}/{embedId}.js. The embed ID rides in the path after a five-minute cache window. event.api.drift.com collect is not contracted.

params.name: embed_id
params.description: It is the Drift embed ID. Drift documents the loader as js.driftt.com/include/{timestamp}/{embedId}.js and drift.load('embedId').
params.fix_hint: Copy the snippet from Drift Install so the path ends in /{embedId}.js.

params.name: cache_bust
params.description: It is the cache window Drift computes as Math.ceil(Date.now()/300000)*300000. The published snippet puts it in the path before the embed ID.
params.fix_hint: Keep the timestamp segment the Drift snippet writes. It is not the embed ID.
